claims: The Masters Tournament is played annually at Augusta National Golf Club in Augusta, Georgia, USA.
The Masters Tournament is the only one of the four major championships in professional men's golf that is held at the same venue every year.
The Masters Tournament generally takes place during the first full week of April.
Augusta National Golf Club was founded in 1934 by Bobby Jones and Clifford Roberts.
Augusta National Golf Club is a private club.
The 2026 Masters Tournament was played April 6–12.
The other major championships in professional men's golf rotate locations.
